node.title: Budget-three fiber-two mismatch coupling has a radical-free trace resolvent
node.statement: For the generic canonical fiber-two cycle denominator-mismatch strata, the 24+6 binary-quartic invariant packet has a radical-free constant-degree elimination. In c=2, each source class depends on a denominator pair only through z=(A+B)^2/(AB); the six values are the roots of an explicit degree-six symmetric pair-trace resolvent R_D, while outer matching is the degree-three equation 4I_out^3 z(z-36)^2-J_out^2(z+12)^3=0. Thus c=2 is exactly Res(R_D,K_out)=0. In c=1, reducing each sign test in F[u]/(u^2-BD) and taking its quadratic norm replaces 24 tests by twelve explicit base-field norm equations. No mismatch candidate is excluded and no official-order computation is authorized.
